announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l10 — Multi-device usage refresh
announcements.summary: Per-device usage refresh and status reporting for shared accounts.
announcements.content:
This local release improves shared account usage updates across devices.
1. Refreshing an account can request fresh usage from each active follower device.
2. Follower scans run locally and return encrypted results or an explicit failure status.
3. The Dashboard keeps the previous value and shows each device's refresh time and status.
4. Local usage refresh remains independent from follower usage refresh.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l10 — 多设备用量刷新
zh.summary: 为共享账号增加按设备刷新用量和状态显示。
zh.content:
本地发布版改进了共享账号的跨设备用量更新。
1. 刷新账号时可以向每台活动从设备请求最新用量。
2. 从设备在本机执行统计，并返回加密结果或明确的失败状态。
3. Dashboard 保留上一份有效用量，同时显示各设备的统计时间和刷新状态。
4. 本机用量刷新与从设备用量刷新保持独立。
